what: Text reveal — text is split into characters inside word chunks, and from the first character on, at a .05s stagger, each resolves from blur 10px · 10px below · transparent over .6s cubic-bezier(.58,0,.42,1). With word-level splitting (split: word), long text such as card body copy resolves word by word.

options.on: load (default, runs after the delay once attached) · scroll (once when it reaches 85% of the screen, needs ScrollTrigger) · state (each time fx:show arrives on the element — delayed via detail.delay, fx:hide hides it again)
options.delay: Delay (sec), default 0 — original entrance door title 3.8, subtitle 4.2
options.start: Start of on: scroll, default top 85%
options.[data-fx-part=char]: (optional) already-split pieces — if present, they are used instead of splitting

from.where: index.html .fh-gate__title·.fh-room__title·.fh-card__body(Framer appear effect: blur(10px)·y10·opacity .001 → 0, tokenization character, transition delay .05 duration .6 ease [.58,0,.42,1], startDelay 3.8·4.2)

note: When splitting <em> Keep the same inner styling and split only the text inside. Remove it to restore the original html.
